package.name: sensors
package.description: Sensor-level processing for the ERC 2026 head RGBD camera. Rebuilds the depth-camera point cloud that the Gazebo rgbd_camera advertises but never fills (back-projecting the float32 depth image through camera_info) and applies an Intel RealSense D435-like noise model (range-dependent disparity noise, sub-pixel quantisation, edge holes) so the cloud looks like a real sensor's. Publishes a normal sensor_msgs/PointCloud2 plus a field-of-view frustum marker.
